stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev gewinnt Finale der US Open

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev wins US Open final
en.summary: Alexander Zverev defeated American Ben Shelton to win the US Open. The victory puts Zverev in position to reach the world number one ranking for the first time.

stories.title: US Open: Finalgegner beklagt sich über Verhalten von Alexander Zverev beim Aufschlag

en.title: US Open: Final opponent complains about Alexander Zverev's serve conduct
en.summary: Ben Shelton criticized Alexander Zverev's behavior during serves following his US Open final loss. Other players have raised similar complaints about Zverev's conduct.

stories.title: Schweden-Wahl: Sozialdemokraten stärkste Kraft – Ausgang offen

en.title: Swedish election: Social Democrats strongest force – outcome open
en.summary: Sweden's Social Democrats received approximately 28 percent of votes in partial results. The left bloc holds a narrow lead over the center-right coalition of the incumbent prime minister, with the final outcome uncertain.

stories.title: US Open - Sieg von Alexander Zverev: »Ein neuer König in New York« – Pressestimmen im Überblick

en.title: US Open - Alexander Zverev victory: "A new king in New York" – press reactions overview
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won the US Open for the first time, earning widespread international praise. Media outlets noted amusement that Zverev initially appeared unaware of his own victory.

stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev gewinnt Finale in New York gegen Ben Shelton

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev wins final in New York against Ben Shelton
en.summary: German tennis player Alexander Zverev won the US Open for the first time, defeating American Ben Shelton in the final.

stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev schreibt gegen Ben Shelton Geschichte

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev makes history against Ben Shelton
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won the US Open for the first time, defeating American Ben Shelton in the final and becoming the second German man to win the title after Boris Becker.

stories.title: Tennisprofi Alexander Zverev krönt sich zum US-Open-Sieger

en.title: Tennis professional Alexander Zverev crowned US Open champion
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won the US Open, becoming the second German after Boris Becker to achieve this feat. The French Open champion defeated American Ben Shelton in the New York final to secure his second Grand Slam title.

stories.title: US Open im Tennis: Zverev gewinnt seinen nächsten Grand-Slam-Titel

en.title: US Open tennis: Zverev wins his next Grand Slam title
en.summary: Alexander Zverev captured his second Grand Slam title by winning the US Open, adding to his French Open victory earlier in the year with a decisive victory over American Ben Shelton.

stories.title: Zweiter Major-Titel: Alexander Zverevs Meisterstück im US-Open-Finale

en.title: Second major title: Alexander Zverev's masterpiece in the US Open final
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won his second Grand Slam title at the US Open with a commanding performance against American Ben Shelton in New York.

stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev gewinnt gegen Ben Shelton in vier Sätzen

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev defeats Ben Shelton in four sets
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won the US Open men's singles title by defeating Ben Shelton with a nearly flawless performance.

en.title: Football Bundesliga: Kane rescues FC Bayern from embarrassment at Elversberg
en.summary: FC Bayern Munich narrowly won against newly promoted Elversberg, with striker Kane delivering crucial goals to preserve the team's victory.

stories.title: Basketball-WM: Deutsche Basketballerinnen verlieren gegen Spanien im Spiel um Bronze

en.title: Basketball World Cup: German women's team loses bronze medal match against Spain
en.summary: Germany's women's basketball team lost their third-place playoff against Spain, though the home tournament was among the most successful in the history of German women's basketball.

stories.title: Kommunalwahl: Niedersachsen hat gewählt – AfD verdreifacht Ergebnis, CDU vor SPD

en.title: Municipal elections: Lower Saxony votes – AfD triples result, CDU ahead of SPD
en.summary: Six million voters in Lower Saxony participated in local elections influenced by the Volkswagen crisis, with the AfD significantly increasing its share and the CDU outperforming the SPD.

stories.title: Kommentar: Commerzbank-Übernahme – Bundesregierung wird vom Blockierer zum Bittsteller

en.title: Commentary: Commerzbank takeover – German government shifts from blocker to supplicant
en.summary: Finance Minister Klingbeil met with Unicredit CEO Orcel regarding the Commerzbank acquisition, signaling a change in the government's approach but from a weakened negotiating position.

en.title: Renewable Energy: Experts Warn: Reiche's Grid Package Produces Unnecessary Costs
en.summary: Federal Economics Minister Katherina Reiche aims to better synchronize renewable energy expansion with grid development. However, experts caution that the approach may result in avoidable expenses.

stories.title: Parlamentswahl: Sozialdemokraten bei Wahl in Schweden vorn – Ausgang offen

en.title: Parliamentary election: Social Democrats ahead in Sweden – outcome open
en.summary: Sweden's Social Democrats lead in the parliamentary election, threatening Prime Minister Kristersson's grip on power. However, it remains unclear which party or coalition will form the next government.
